_comment: HOME MENU (owner 2026-10-22, second pass): the hamburger's Apps section shows CATEGORIES, never bare links. `categories` is the order they appear in. Every card in the Apps chip carries a `category`; home.js groups them under it. Every report in apps/reports/reports.json is listed under `reportsCategory` (owner: all reports go under Shopping Apps). Owner 2026-10-22: `Maps` is a TOP-LEVEL menu section beside Apps, not an Apps category - home.js sends any app whose `category` is `Maps` (Budget, Datacenter, AISD) to that section. What can I build here? stays under Culture Apps. Move any app by editing its `category` word. The demo reel still runs: cards marked demo cycle in the window until the visitor picks something. Chips other than Apps are unused. OLDER NOTE, kept for the record: Home page chips and cards (owner-named chips, 2026-09-09). Card titles/blurbs are copied verbatim from CityAnatomyAustin/src/content/copy.ts; the owner writes all copy. THE SITE IS A HOLDER FOR THE WEB APPS (owner 2026-09-10). A CARD OPENS ITS WEB APP (`app`) in a new browser window - clicking a card does not change what plays in the map window. A card with no `app` but a `src` is the old kind and still previews in the window. THE WINDOW PLAYS A DEMO REEL: a chip marked `cycle: true` runs through its cards marked `demo: true` in order, each holding the window for `demoMs` (default 60000) before the next. The demos are animations only - nothing in them responds to a click. The chip with `open: true` is what the page opens on (Apps, so the reel starts straight away). A chip may still carry its own `src` and no cards, which makes it a page in itself loaded into the window - no chip uses that now (the News Feed chip was removed 2026-09-10), but it is how you would put a page back on the home page without writing code. A chip may carry `from`: a URL of apps/reports/reports.json shape; home.js turns each report into a card that opens the report's MapLibre map app at /apps/reports/<id>/.
